pr_title: Fix osu! (slider) combo not matching expectations when classic mod is disabled
pr_body:
RFC

- [x] Depends on https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/25341

See 818432fab4279b6691286483b6be88eb663e84c3's diff for the important part.

Should close https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/21815. This would also bring the "slider end combo break" behaviour in line with expectations for non-classic mod. Fixing in classic mod is still a mess (see https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/11769).

There two ways of looking at this:

- This brings things close in line with expectations so it seems like a good starting point to build off.
- This doesn't fix the other issues we're attempting to navigate so it's pointless to even consider.
pr_comments:
> There two ways of looking at this:
> * This brings things close in line with expectations so it seems like a good starting point to build off.
> * This doesn't fix the other issues we're attempting to navigate so it's pointless to even consider.

As for this, I think we're no worse-off with this diff than we were previously, so may as well entertain it and see where we end up.

Also tests failing (albeit that may be fixed by addressing reviews above)

I'm not sure whether to do this now or wait to get slider judgements behaving the same as osu-stable first, because I think we can probably agree that the legacy mechanics are something that we have to take forward at this point...

issue_context.title: PP values displayed in lazer client and on website aren't the same
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

I set a score on Lazer. The client showed me I got 89pp. But the [score page on the website](https://lazer.ppy.sh/scores/2165163328) shows 71pp.
Another more different [play on the website shows 68pp](https://lazer.ppy.sh/scores/2165314696), but in the client was 81pp. (Second screenshot)

comments: This appears to be #19386 combined with the website showing lazer scores.
Likely explanation provided here https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/12542#issuecomment-1366192979
Also reported externally (https://twitter.com/GreyMatterMr/status/1608580668120010753)
@smoogipoo going to leave this one to you
@smoogipoo any idea on the state of this? is it fine to close as something which we'll ensure is correct when resetting the leaderboards? or worth investigating imminently?

I'm not really sure on the state of this, and I personally don't think it's too important for the time being. I want to see how things are after the leaderboard reset and reassess at that time. The linked issue is quite full of data that is hard to look through.
The problem very much still is a thing if that's what you want to know @peppy.
Thanks, we'll mak sure to check after redeploying all components more close to score reset. Please re-check from your end at a later date.

I'm still getting this issue in the latest version (2023.914.0).
PP scores on the website are consistently lower than the ones reported after a game by about 20-30%.
This also happened on the previous version, although I don't have the exact version number for it.

(Apologies in case the mentioned redeploy hasn't happened yet)

Issue is still present in 2023.1026.0-lazer.
just got a score displaying as 64pp in game and 48pp when checking my profile.

> Issue is still present in 2023.1026.0-lazer.
> 
> just got a score displaying as 64pp in game and 48pp when checking my profile.

Please provide links and screenshots showing what you are seeing.

Here is a fresh example (the difference is present consistently on every single play and it was easier to get screenshots on a fresh play), still version 2023.1026.0-lazer
The Result screen in game directly after finishing the beatmap (27pp):
![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/31819497/48c0b802-be79-4931-a1ee-0ff00df38d4c)
The Performance Breakdown (also directly after finishing the beatmap, same 27pp):
![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/31819497/f45139ff-a1e7-42ec-81d5-d7583ea8c2b3)
Viewing Recent Plays in my Profile in game (22pp):
![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/31819497/b812dddd-0bc9-4e90-a780-83b6a75bbd28)
Viewing Recent play in my profile on lazer.ppy.sh (osu.ppy.sh shows pp as `-` since it was a score set in lazer) (22pp):
![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/31819497/56a18a34-ae96-4230-9f9e-a964d66bfca1)

I still have the issue as well. PP displayed in my profile are lower than the ones displayed after a play, or in the score list of the beatmap in the beatmap selection screen. Using the Classic mod fixes this and makes PP counts consistent. Other mods don't seem to have any effect. Viewing a nomod score after setting it (20PP): Viewing a classic mod score after setting it (39PP): Viewing both scores in my profile (15 and 39PP respectively): Viewing both scores on lazer.ppy.sh (also 15 and 39PP):
I'm guessing this is going to be due to diffcalc changes which haven't been deployed yet? And if so, we should probably try and get a new `score-statistic-processor` out in some form..

> And if so, we should probably try and get a new `score-statistic-processor` out in some form..

Currently blocked by https://github.com/ppy/osu-infrastructure/issues/15, unless you want to try the new processors live without the indices and see if they handle the load well enough.

A new score statistics processor is not going to fix this. The issue in the above few posters appears to be the use of non-classic mod, whereas we only store and use classic-mod difficulty attributes to the table.


I don't know what the proper way to solve this is -- either we store non-classic-mod difficulty attributes to the table; doubling its size, or we use the realtime difficulty processing capability of the processor which hasn't been tested (and I've wanted to test it for exactly this reason about a year now).

For the most part, this is just an issue of combo.
Or I guess we just agree that mods should not change max combo of a map?

Can that be enforced even with the current mod selection? For example, doesn't mania's no holds mod change combo? In that particular case, the mod itself is "pp-unranked", but what about when it starts to give pp?
Yeah okay I forgot about that one. Target probably too, etc.
For the majority case, it seems like matching osu! ruleset no mod combo would resolve this (already on my list).
